class_id: the web build breaks while the PR gate stays green
feature: any relative import inside packages/shared/src that is `.js`-suffixed (NodeNext-style, so tsc/tsx resolve it to the sibling `.ts` file), once it becomes reachable from a `web/**` file — directly or transitively through another shared module
symptom: packages/shared/src/tsconfig.json and web/tsconfig.json both use `moduleResolution: bundler`/tsc's NodeNext-compatible resolution, which silently maps a `.js`-suffixed relative import to its `.ts` source file. Next.js's production build runs its own webpack pass, and webpack's default resolver does NOT do that remap — it looks for a literal `./foo.js` file, does not find one (only `foo.ts` exists), and fails with `Module not found: Can't resolve './foo.js'`. `web/tsc --noEmit`, `eslint`, and every unit/integration test pass cleanly because none of them run webpack; the PR gate (`pr-gate.yml`) runs exactly those three and never runs `next build`. So a PR that adds or deepens an import chain from `web/**` into a `.js`-suffixed shared import merges green, and the break is discovered only when something actually runs `next build` — a staging or prod deploy.
first_seen: 2026-09-24 21:30 IST staging deploy window, GitHub Actions run 36024250816, deploying main @ 03359ba2. `next build` failed at `../packages/shared/src/utils/duplicate-ipo-merge.ts:12` — `Module not found: Can't resolve './company-identity-fold.js'` — import trace `web/app/api/admin/conflicts/route.ts` -> `web/lib/services/conflict-resolution.ts` -> `packages/shared/src/services/corrigendum-suggestions.ts` -> `packages/shared/src/repositories/ipo-repository.ts` -> `packages/shared/src/utils/duplicate-ipo-merge.ts`. The reachable chain was created by PR #989, which made a `web/lib/services/*` file import a shared SOURCE service directly (rather than only via the compiled `@ipodhan/shared` package). Every merge from #989 onward passed `pr-gate.yml` (lint + type-check + unit tests) with the staging build silently broken underneath. Reproduced on `origin/main` locally 2026-09-24 (`cd web && npm run build` fails with the identical error and trace); fails identically on any of the 4 other `.js`-suffixed relative imports in `packages/shared/src` (`repositories/field-source-overrides-repository.ts` x2 -> `../db/schema.js`, `repositories/ipo-identity.ts` -> `../utils/company-identity-fold.js`) the moment any of them becomes reachable from `web/**`.
fix_prs: web/next.config.mjs webpack config gets `resolve.extensionAlias = { '.js': ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js'] }`, merged into the existing webpack function (Sentry wrapper kept intact) — this makes webpack apply the same .js->.ts remap tsc/tsx already do, so every current and future `.js`-suffixed shared import resolves under `next build` too, at the class level rather than renaming import sites one file at a time. A second, unrelated pre-existing type error surfaced once the build got past module resolution (packages/shared/src/repositories/ipo-source-keys.ts:376, `check.reason` typed `string | undefined` assigned to a `string` field) and was fixed at the call site with a fallback string, since it was previously invisible for the same reason (next build's type-check step never ran to completion).
detection_check: Guarded by TWO checks, because the fast one alone missed the second half of the incident. (1) scripts/ci/check-shared-js-imports-resolve.mjs, wired into pr-gate.yml's `gate` job as a pure-fs step before `npm ci` (no install/build needed, seconds): finds every `.js`-suffixed relative import in packages/shared/src whose literal target file does not exist and fails the PR unless web/next.config.mjs carries the matching `resolve.extensionAlias` guard. Proven RED on origin/main's next.config.mjs (exit 1, names all 4 offending imports) and GREEN on the fix branch (exit 0). This check structurally cannot catch a type error `next build`'s type-check step only reaches after module resolution succeeds (the actual second failure this incident hit, ipo-source-keys.ts:376) — a resolve check has no way to see a type-check-only failure. (2) The `web-build` job in `pr-gate.yml` (name: "Web production build (next build)"): runs the REAL `cd web && npm run build` — the exact command that failed in staging run 36024250816 — path-filtered (via a git diff on the PR's base/head shas) to only run when `web/**` or `packages/shared/**` changed, so it costs nothing on unrelated PRs. No Sentry/DB/Redis env vars are set; the local proof build succeeded with none set either. First run on PR #1008 (this fix): <CI_TIME_FIRST_RUN>. This is the only one of the two checks that would have caught BOTH failures the incident actually hit.
